svg.title: Visual abstract: An interpretable VAE for TF rewiring
svg.desc: VEGA variational autoencoders with transcription-factor latent nodes and a CollecTRI-masked decoder are trained separately on IFN-beta stimulated and control PBMCs (16,893 cells). Decoder weights reveal TF rewiring such as STAT1 to CCL8 (+0.104), STAT2 to IFIT2 (+0.074) and IRF1 to RSAD2 (+0.062), with uncertainty from ensembles, stochastic weight averaging and Bayesian layers.

Interferon-β rewires STAT1, STAT2 and IRF1 toward interferon-stimulated genes such as CCL8, IFIT2 and
RSAD2, while ensembles, SWA and Bayesian layers show which of these links are certain.
